I had one of the worst experiences at this hotel. The staff were extremely rude and unprofessional, showing no respect or basic courtesy to guests. To make it worse, they overcharged me with some ridiculous “policy” that made absolutely no sense and refused to listen when I tried to explain.
The entire stay left a bitter taste — poor service, arrogant attitude, and zero value for money. I would strongly advise others to avoid this place unless you want to be treated disrespectfully and overbilled for no reason.

I had a very unpleasant stay at this hotel. The staff’s behaviour was extremely rude and unprofessional throughout my visit. Despite confirming the prices in advance, I was overcharged at checkout with no proper explanation.

There was constant disturbance — people knocking on the door and calling unnecessarily, which completely ruined the peace I was expecting during my stay. To make matters worse, the hotel closes its lift facilities at night, causing a lot of inconvenience, especially for us staying at third floor.

Overall, this was one of the most uncomfortable and frustrating hotel experiences I’ve had.
Very rude reception, they don't care about the customer experience. They close the lift after 7, so if you want to ho out in night you have to use the stairs those are also closed.
